newsitem.title: UK: Helical gets 50 mln stg from L&G for parks.
newsitem.headline: Helical gets 50 mln stg from L&G for parks.

text.p: British property and development group Helical Bar Plc said on Thursday its retail arm had pre-sold two retail parks to Legal & General Group Plc for 50 million stg.

A 15-acre site in Norwich, eastern England, will be developed into a 150,000 square feet retail park. It is adjacent to an existing 65,000 sq ft Sainsbury Superstore and together they will be the biggest out of town retail park in Norwich, the group said in a statement.
Completion of the whole development is set for June 1998.
The other site, a 12-acre development in Bolton, north west England, adjoins a town centre site Helical Retail acquired last year.
Together they will create a 120,000 sq ft retail park, detailed planning for which has already been obtained.
